-  # Let a provider run finish its owned-object cleanup before the next run.
-  cancel-in-progress: false
-
-jobs:
-  spaces:
-    name: 🦈 DigitalOcean Spaces
-    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
-    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
-    timeout-minutes: 10
-    steps:
-      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
-        with:
-          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
-          persist-credentials: false
-      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
-        with:
-          node-version-file: .nvmrc
-          package-manager-cache: false
-      - name: Inspect available credential format without disclosing values
-        id: capability
-        env:
-          DIGITAL_OCEAN_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.DIGITAL_OCEAN_ACCESS_KEY }}
-          DIGITAL_OCEAN_ENDPOINT: ${{ secrets.DIGITAL_OCEAN_ENDPOINT }}
-          DIGITAL_OCEAN_SECRET_KEY: ${{ secrets.DIGITAL_OCEAN_SECRET_KEY }}
-          SPACES_ACCEPTANCE_COMMIT: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
-        run: node scripts/deploy/spaces-acceptance.ts --probe
-      - name: Install without provider credentials
-        if: steps.capability.outputs.ready == 'true'
-        run: |
-          npm ci
-          node scripts/ci/prefer-ubuntu-archive.ts
-          sudo apt-get update
-          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends tini
-      - name: Verify encrypted provider backups and supervised catalog restore
-        if: steps.capability.outputs.ready == 'true'
-        env:
-          DIGITAL_OCEAN_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.DIGITAL_OCEAN_ACCESS_KEY }}
-          DIGITAL_OCEAN_ENDPOINT: ${{ secrets.DIGITAL_OCEAN_ENDPOINT }}
-          DIGITAL_OCEAN_SECRET_KEY: ${{ secrets.DIGITAL_OCEAN_SECRET_KEY }}
-          SPACES_ACCEPTANCE_COMMIT: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
-        # Keep recovery's process inventory inside the same production-like PID
-        # boundary used by controller tests. Original provider credentials pass
-        # privately through the wrapper's stdin, never shell arguments or logs.
-        run: node scripts/ci/pid-namespace.ts node scripts/deploy/spaces-acceptance.ts
-      - name: Preserve redacted acceptance evidence
-        if: always()
-        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
-        with:
-          name: spaces-acceptance
-          path: artifacts/spaces-acceptance.json
-          if-no-files-found: warn
-          retention-days: 14

-  persistence, native/platform investigation and verification; record early scope
-  checkpoints. Splits retain every remaining requirement and its estimate, so a

-  dispositions; comments and expiring artifacts only supplement that record.

-  implementation/review/integration/evidence branch after rechecking its head
-  and active PR ownership. Record access-blocked cleanup explicitly. Owner, chat

-  assign each environment a distinct purpose. Keep source/shared dependencies
-  in the CI plan and prove selected missing/failed work cannot pass. Apply this
-  in the ticket's Verify section, progress checkpoints and PR evidence. Repair
-  test weaknesses introduced by the ticket before landing; separate cleanup
-  tickets cannot replace its acceptance. Owner, chat 2026-11-01 (SPN-115).

   needs a pattern the playbook doesn't cover adds it there in its own PR first,
   and every new component or state gets a Storybook story. Owner, chat

+## Explicit schema 3 amendment
+
+The initial contract required baseline Redo success. The corrected shortcut and
+exact native reproduction exposed a 166,056-byte redo mutation array and a 166,206-byte
+reserved envelope (fixture unit ID `doc`), exceeding the unchanged 65,536-byte
+wire limit. Typing and Undo passed actual ACK/hash verification; Redo restored
+locally then refused sync admission with `capacity`. Browser UUIDs alter the
+exact envelope size.
+
+Schema3 was adopted after baseline observation and before any candidate
+measurement. It separates primary timing and initial integrity from Redo
+outcome. Only the baseline may report `baseline-capacity-refusal`: exact
+successful empty Undo, actual Ctrl+Y, exactly one same-unit sender capacity reload
+with clean:false inside the recorded Redo phase, and exact empty saved/peer/local
+recovery at the unchanged revision. Every other failure remains blocking.
+Candidate content, selections, full original-workload replay, no reloads and
+all latency targets remain mandatory. Old schema 2 and incomplete cases stay failed.

+## Retention and independent review
+
+The public record contains inspected numeric results, dispositions and checksums.
+The durable private measurement bundle supplied to the owner preserves raw CPU
+profiles, clock sidecars, input/long-task timelines, phase snapshots, manifests,
+test reports and logs beyond the seven-day Actions retention. Screenshots remain
+in the original CI artifacts. Automatic approval review rejected bulk public
+publication of the complete mixed CI ZIP; that payload is not republished.
+
+Two nonimplementing reviewers must each score above 95/100 on the same final
+candidate and have no blockers, after inspecting fresh paired raw evidence and
+all current required checks. Passing retries, historical scores and a matching
+tree alone do not establish acceptance.
